checked_classes: complete sibling set — packet includes spec.md, manifest, all six OpenSpec changes, proposals, designs, tasks, capability deltas, reference specs, and verification evidence; manifest artifact count matches the provided artifact inventory
F1-F8 traceability — spec.md maps every feedback area F1 through F8 to named changes and scenario groups, including split F3 P0/P1 and F6/F8 evaluation coverage

testability — each capability delta contains concrete SHALL requirements with scenario-level WHEN/THEN criteria, and task files require fixture/evidence mapping before execution rather than relying on vague acceptance

MODIFIED/REMOVED contract migration — existing contradictory eval CI and tool-history requirements are explicitly REMOVED with migration targets, and modified requirements preserve or replace prior scenarios with new explicit outcomes

dependency and ordering consistency — manifest dependencies and spec.md implementation order are consistent as harness-protected-context → model-profiles-routing → task-graph-lifecycle → skill-activation-quality → knowledge-evidence → governed-evaluation

research prerequisite enforcement — spec.md and affected design/tasks preserve the analyze-stage warning by blocking F4-F8 implementation commitments until the five targeted external-candidate evaluations are recorded

project constraints — artifact keeps mutations host-owned, preserves dependency pins/current UI, keeps product verification local, limits GitHub Actions to deployment validation, preserves Recall@10 >=99% and frontend coverage >=60%, and treats Tier 3 as a separate local milestone required for phase completion

scope consistency — changes are tied to stated goals and assessment/analysis handoffs; no dependency upgrade, dashboard removal, marketplace/channel expansion, deployment, release, or runtime fix claim is introduced
